title: Book One · Chapter 17: The Long String
story:
Leo brings more string on Sunday. He keeps it on a piece of card.

"This will go right over the roof," he says.

Ronan looks up at the yard roof. "We can't fly it here."

"I mean later."

They put Jun's unfinished kite in the room. They take their own kite outside. It has the blue tail. Mum walks them to the school yard. She sits on the low wall with her sewing bag. A teacher opened the side gate after lunch.

The wind moves Mum's loose hair. It feels like a good kite wind to Ronan. He wants to try at once. He does not stop to check the wind.

Leo lets out a long line. It lies in loops on the ground.

"That's too much," Ronan says.

"It needs space."

"The space is on the floor."

Leo shakes the card. A loop catches around his shoe. He lifts his foot, but another loop catches the first one.

Ronan holds the kite with both hands. The tail hangs down to the ground. He lifts it with one hand.

"Come here," Leo says.

"I can't. You're tied to the ground."

Mum looks up at the sound of their voices. She asks them to stop pulling. Ronan lays the kite on a clean cloth beside her. Then both boys sit down by Leo's shoe.

Leo pulls one end. The knot gets smaller. Ronan pulls the other. It becomes hard as a little bead.

"Now what?" Leo asks.

Mum finds a needle in her bag. Its point is sharp. She puts it away. She takes out a wooden pick instead. Its end is not sharp.

"I'll open this knot. You find a better place for the loose line."

The boys watch the loops lift free. They walk the string out in a straight path beside the wall. No one needs the whole long length yet. They wind most of it back onto the card.

Ronan pulls out a short length of string. He ties a scrap of cloth there. They will stop at that mark each time.

Leo holds the kite. Ronan walks back. Mum stands to one side. The string cannot catch her there.

"Ready."

The kite rises a little. Its tail hangs low. Then the top of the kite turns down. Ronan stops before it hits the ground hard.

It does the same thing on the next try. And the next.

"More string won't fix that," Leo says.

Ronan feels cross, but Leo isn't laughing. He is looking at the top of the kite.

They take the kite to the wall. The paper under the middle knot is beginning to bend. The tail knot still holds. The strips are still straight.

"Is the kite better now?" Mum asks.

"It falls with a short string, too," Ronan says.

"And no shoe on the string," Leo adds.

They draw two little pictures on their test paper. The first shows the shoe and a large cross. The second shows the kite pointing down.

"Those are different problems," Ronan says.

Mum nods and puts her sewing away. The school gate will close soon.

On the walk home, Leo carries the kite. Ronan carries the card. He winds the loose end carefully around it. The string stays on the card this time. He puts it beside the kite at home. It will be easier to use next time.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：loops＝线圈；knot＝绳结；string＝线；mark＝标记。

辅助理解：wooden pick＝木质小签；sharp＝尖的；card＝硬纸片。

理解问题：

1. 线太长时给两人造成了什么困难？
2. 他们怎样让下一次试验更容易看清问题？
